title: Your week
trip.a11y_one: {date}: shopping day, {count} item. Open the list
trip.a11y_other: {date}: shopping day, {count} items. Open the list
edit.hint: To change just one meal, tap it or press and hold.
regenerate.title: Regenerate the menu?
regenerate.text: New recipes for upcoming meals you haven't cooked yet. Completed meals, manual picks, purchases and pantry stay as they are.
meal.hint: Opens the recipe. Press and hold to change, move or mark the meal.
actions.alreadyDone: Meal already logged: ingredients weren't subtracted again.
actions.shortfall: Meal logged. Not in your pantry: {list}.
actions.repropose: Suggest “{recipe}” again for your next free {meal}? Ingredients bought for this meal stay in your pantry.
actions.noFreeSlot: No free meal of the same type in this plan.
replace.locked: This meal can't be changed anymore.
replace.intro: {meal} on {date} · now: {recipe}. All alternatives respect your exclusions; the ones using what you already have come first.
replace.none: No alternatives match your preferences for this meal.
move.locked: This meal can't be moved anymore.
move.intro: Choose which {meal} to swap with “{recipe}”. Your shopping list updates by itself.
move.none: No other meals of this type to swap.
repeat.intro: Choose the meal to replace with “{recipe}”.
repeat.incompatibleText: This recipe has ingredients you've excluded or needs equipment you haven't listed: it can't be added to your plan.
repeat.none: No compatible meal to replace in this plan.
cheaper.nothing: Your plan is already as simple as it gets with your preferences: I can't find swaps that cut costs without repeating dishes or breaking your limits.
cheaper.estimate: Estimate: from about {before} to about {after} (prices you know).
cheaper.purchases: Different products to buy: from {before} to {after}. I'm not showing a money saving because some prices are missing.
cheaper.overLimit: Even so, the estimate is over your limit: you can raise your budget or change some preferences.
cheaper.unchanged: Cooked meals and confirmed purchases won't change.
cheaper.footnote: Alternatives respect all your food exclusions, the time you have and the number of people.
